title: Track company assets and equipment
summary: When buying, assigning, moving, returning or disposing of company equipment. A reconciled asset register with accountable custodians and verified authorized disposal or return.
outcomes: A reconciled asset register with accountable custodians and verified authorized disposal or return.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When buying, assigning, moving, returning or disposing of company equipment.

parts.title: Build the asset and custody register
parts.guidance: Record the equipment, serial or asset identifier, purchase evidence, custodian, location and relevant warranty. Distinguish owned, leased, customer and personally owned property.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve purchasing and handling responsibilities
parts.guidance: The accountable owners confirm assignment, physical security, maintenance, insurance and return expectations. Use the payment and purchasing approval process for new commitments.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Record approved assignment and configuration
parts.guidance: Authorized operators tag assets, issue equipment and link it to the relevant access or device-management controls. Verify receipt and document exceptions without exposing credentials in the asset record.

execution.rationale: An authorized custodian physically tags and hands over equipment, verifies receipt and records the assignment. Browser operation cannot perform the physical handover.

parts.title: Reconcile physical holdings and changes
parts.guidance: Custodians confirm assets, condition and location on the agreed cadence. Investigate missing equipment and coordinate lost-device or security response where needed.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Authorize return, reuse or disposal
parts.guidance: Verify ownership, retention needs and data sanitization before transfer or disposal. Retain return or disposal evidence and reconcile the asset, accounting and access records.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

verify.how: A reconciled asset register with accountable custodians and verified authorized disposal or return.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
